rubrics.grocery_utilization: Judge whether the response makes useful use of the stated pantry, minimizes avoidable purchases and honestly explains shortages. Ingredient matching alone does not establish a good meal. When stock is insufficient, an explicit reasonable shopping plan is preferable to pretending ingredients are available.
rubrics.feasibility: Judge whether preparation, quantities, total elapsed time, equipment assumptions and techniques form a practical meal at the stated skill. A realistic clarification for an impossible request scores highly; invented time or silently changing the requested dish scores poorly. Consider taste/nutrition conflicts without overriding allergies or restrictions.
rubrics.controlled_creativity: Judge useful, coherent flavor, presentation or technique adaptations within all stated constraints. Novelty is not mandatory for ordinary requests. For an explicitly creative request, merely renaming an unchanged dish is weak. Distinguish an honestly labeled adaptation from a claimed source fact. Reward practical adaptations, never invented nutrition, safety or external claims.

scale.1: Fails the criterion or makes unsupported claims.
scale.3: Partially useful but has a material unresolved weakness.
scale.4: Meets the criterion with only minor weaknesses.
scale.5: Fully meets the criterion with specific, attributable support.

anchors.query: Suggest a vegetarian beginner carrot rice dinner in 30 minutes using rice, carrots and olive oil.
anchors.response: Cook 100 g rice, soften 150 g carrot with 10 g olive oil, then combine. Two servings, 25 minutes, beginner skill. These are the available groceries. Source fact: the source describes beginner carrot rice taking 25 minutes. Adaptation: dice the carrots finely for a softer texture; this is a proposed variation, not a quoted source property. Nutrition is unavailable; no nutrient amount or health benefit is claimed.
anchors.context: Source: synthetic-rice-v1. Beginner carrot rice with olive oil takes 25 minutes. Pantry: 200 g rice, 200 g carrot, 20 g olive oil.
anchors.grounded_response: Beginner carrot rice with olive oil takes 25 minutes.
